decision_lens: Prioritize batches with multiple novel systems in one pass (overscoped) or no testable integration point (underscoped).
focus: Whether each batch is correctly scoped — not overloaded or underloaded for its day estimate
name: fd-batch-scope-calibration
persona: An experienced technical PM who has shipped Rust simulation games. Uses LOC, test count, and interaction complexity as proxies.
review_areas: Batch 3 (3 days) introduces 5 novel subsystems simultaneously — is 3 days realistic?
Batch 1 (1 day) adds many new component types alongside all AF port work — too high?
Batch 8 includes save/load — should that be earlier to protect integration tests?
Batch 5 (3 days) implements 6-state revel machine + 4 emergent events — correctly estimated?
Batch 9 (2 days) asks for integration tests + tuning + data expansion — realistic?
Batch 6 (2 days) covers DummyCurator + trait + policies + events + state_export — fits?
success_hints: No batch has more than 2 novel systems alongside porting work
Each batch has an integration test catching regressions from the next batch
Day estimates sum ≤25 and critical path ≤20 days
task_context: MVP plan ports agent-fortress to elf-revel across 10 batches, each claimed independently testable.
